enabled.description: Whether checks run automatically on this schedule.

interval.description:
How often all enabled checks on the subject run.

* `1hour` - 1hour
* `6hour` - 6hour
* `12hour` - 12hour
* `24hour` - 24hour
* `7day` - 7day

subject_type.description:
Kind of object: 'table', 'view', 'metric', or 'posthog_table'.

* `table` - table
* `view` - view
* `metric` - metric
* `posthog_table` - posthog_table

subject_uuid.description: Id of the table, view, metric, or PostHog table.
